question: Does the combined Stage1 treatment improve real-model correctness enough to outweigh a larger run_code header?

parts: catalog expansion: compact signature + short purpose + declared return shape for every scriptable tools.* member instead of names-only nonessentials
honest schema fallback: unconvertible schemas render an explicit marker instead of a bogus zero-argument signature
model-visible schema lookup telemetry: successful tools.describe counts appear on the run_code result summary (N1 KEEP)
combinedTreatment.causality: Do not claim isolated catalog-expansion causality. Arm B differs by the whole combined treatment. Lookup telemetry is model-visible and can shape describe behavior.
combinedTreatment.n1Decision: KEEP model-visible schema lookup telemetry as part of the treatment.

priorDecision.claimedMeasurement: Promoting full signatures for all non-essential tools was measured at ~3.9x header growth (honest delta +8,080 chars over the exact rendered registry). Header stayed names-only; signatures taught at failure time.
priorDecision.caveat: That figure is a plan-doc hint, covers signatures only, and was already wrong once when a receipt used a 9-tool-larger stub registry (+10,482). Stage1 must re-measure the combined header (signature + purpose + declared returns) against the exact production non-interactive registry. Do not treat any declaration-site count as fact.
priorDecision.supersedeOnlyIf: The three-model comparison shows a correctness win that outweighs the combined header growth. A candidate that improves tokens/time while reducing correctness on any pinned model is rejected before efficiency claims.

protocolReview.conditions: Parent verified G1 (both CLIs rebuilt from current HEADs) and G2 (fresh run, no --resume). G3 is post-hoc reporting.

driver.costControl: Default 2 treated + 2 untreated tasks x 3 trials = 72 cells. Pass --trials 2 to cut cost. Report strata separately; untreated tasks measure cost only.

exclusions: session_list/session_search/session_read (non-interactive CLI does not pass sessionBrowser)
web_search/web_fetch as required actions (network/cost/flake; tools remain on the real registry)
paid subagent fan-out as a required action
